name: Lean Copilot
one_liner: In-editor Lean 4 neural theorem-proving framework combining LLM tactic generation, premise selection, and a best-first proof search tactic that uses the model confidence as score.

loop.proposes: Native CTranslate2 models running inside Lean 4 propose tactics and retrieve premises for the active proof goal.
loop.judged_by: The Lean 4 kernel checks each tactic application and returns updated subgoal states.
loop.steers: A best-first search tactic (`search_proof`) with the model confidence as score explores the proof tree until all goals close.

headline_result: Automates proof goals directly inside Lean 4 workflows with 3.8x faster tactic inference than Python RPC bridges.
caveat: Designed for interactive lemma and subgoal automation rather than multi-hour distributed search.
beyond_harness_note: A native Lean 4 best-first search engine invokes the neural tactic generator and verifies every node in the Lean kernel.
generative_model: ReProver / ByT5 tactic and premise models
algorithmic_authority: Lean 4 kernel and best-first proof search

sources.title: Lean Copilot: Large Language Models as Copilots for Theorem Proving in Lean (arXiv:2404.12534)

verification.notes: Checked against Song et al., arXiv:2404.12534.
